name: Station 8, the Mires (PLAN.md section 9; asked for by the owner, 2026-11-02): the S Outlands' boreal plateau at 5.1 px 1604,721 (legacy 1332,391), Dfb 3.94 km, 1,176 mm, 4 °C; string bogs and their pools (flarks), palsas (KFROST pingos, ice-cored), a stream between peat faces; the comb mast as a bog pine on the strings, the river colony's mire pads and pipe reeds in the pools, the rim colony's frost puffs and ice crust on the palsas; a trapping camp as records; the sink and cold hazards as core/tags records
